verdict.rationale: Background automation, such as scheduled jobs or recurring tasks, is a fair axis for a database platform, but the pack documents no user-configurable automation that runs on its own. Backup docs only call regular backups a best practice and never mention a recurring schedule. Changefeeds and the MCP server are related features, not autonomous automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
